proposals.buyer_persona_hypothesis: Vendor-onboarding workflow designer evaluating registration age as one of several review signals
proposals.baseline_method_hypothesis: Direct free authoritative registry RDAP lookup within an existing vendor identity-check workflow
proposals.proposed_change: Test including domain-age evidence inside an existing composite vendor review instead of marketing it as a standalone paid verdict
proposals.benefit_hypothesis: Preserve useful evidence while reducing fragmented paid calls and overclaiming standalone value

proposals.buyer_persona_hypothesis: Pennsylvania procurement analyst reviewing a newly submitted vendor before onboarding
proposals.baseline_method_hypothesis: Manual separate Pennsylvania registry, OFAC SDN, and authoritative RDAP queries plus analyst consolidation
proposals.proposed_change: Prototype an evidence-linked reviewer brief with explicit uncertainty, missing-source flags, and action codes while preserving human_review boundaries
proposals.benefit_hypothesis: Reduce repeated source lookup and escalation ambiguity without increasing incorrect automatic proceed decisions

proposals.buyer_persona_hypothesis: Local procurement analyst screening a legal registered address against a radius rule
proposals.baseline_method_hypothesis: Manual Pennsylvania registry lookup followed by Census geocoding and separate great-circle distance calculation
proposals.proposed_change: Prototype a provenance-first distance assessment that prominently labels registered-address and straight-line limits, and exposes missing-geocode reasons
proposals.benefit_hypothesis: Reduce reviewer reconciliation work without misrepresenting distance as operational eligibility
